project.name: Good Drinks Australia Corporate Website
project.description: Supported the development and maintenance of the corporate website for Good Drinks Australia, a beverage and brewing company. Contributed to frontend enhancements, WordPress customization, animation effects, SEO improvements, and performance optimization to deliver a modern and engaging digital brand experience.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained custom WordPress features and templates
Implemented responsive frontend layouts and interactive UI components
Created smooth scrolling and animation experiences using GSAP and Lenis
Integrated and customized Gravity Forms for customer interactions
Enhanced SEO structure and metadata using Yoast SEO
Optimized website performance and Cloudflare CDN configuration
Supported Open Graph integration for social media sharing
Maintained reusable JavaScript functionality with jQuery and Swiper
Managed PHP-based backend customizations and WordPress integrations
Improved mobile responsiveness and user experience across devices
highlights: Supported a modern corporate website for a major beverage company
Enhanced user engagement through smooth animations and transitions
Improved SEO visibility and social media integration
Optimized website speed and frontend performance
Contributed to responsive and scalable WordPress development
